title: Four-vehicle crash blocks lanes on southbound I-35 near the 5800 block
excerpt: Four vehicles were involved in a crash Saturday evening on southbound Interstate 35 near the 5800 block in Laredo. Laredo police blocked the far-left and far-right southbound lanes; it was not immediately known if anyone was injured.
content:
A four-vehicle crash was reported Saturday evening on southbound Interstate 35 near the 5800 block in Laredo.

The Laredo Police Department blocked the far-left and far-right southbound lanes around the crash scene, and drivers were warned to expect delays.

Photos from the scene show a dark gray Dodge Durango SUV with severe damage to the front driver side, and an older brown pickup.

It was not immediately known whether anyone was injured. No official statement with further details had been released as of Saturday night.

Source: Laredo Police Department, Facebook, Nov. 21, 2026.
